Для прямого начисления владельцу, наприм: For a direct payout to the owner, such as picking up an Engineer trap, the game takes the debt first and then doubles the rest, if the payout allows Double Cash.
Marketplace, Central Market и Monkey Wal: Marketplace, Central Market and Monkey Wall Street pay this cash to the owner. The per-round amount assumes the farm uses every scheduled payout. Monkey Wall Street's extra payout at the end of the round counts separately. In CHIMPS the game sets these amounts and the IMF Loan payout to zero.
Обычная выработка сразу пополняет банк и: Ordinary income goes straight into the bank and into the base for interest. When interest is paid the game adds the base times the rate to the current balance, caps the sum at the bank's capacity and keeps the result as the new base. A manual deposit joins the base at its next update.
Суммы выработки указаны до лимита банка: Income amounts are before the bank limit and interest. In CHIMPS the income is zero. On collection the cash goes to the farm's owner.
